title: fix: validate polli CLI option values
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Refs #15434: rejects unknown `models --type` values before either list or stats fetches.
- Refs #15435: validates text and chat numeric flags against the API schema before requests.
- Refs #15437: rejects non-HTTP(S) text image values before auth or network access.
- Adds command regression tests; CLI package suite passed (199 tests).
- Quest accounting: only #15440 and #15439 are PR-closing reports in this batch; the other reports are linked and closed manually.

gist.headline: The CLI checks the labels
gist.blurb: Polli now checks the jar before reaching into it. Unknown model types, malformed number flags, and dubious image URLs get caught at the command line instead of being sent on a small network adventure.
gist.summary: The polli CLI now rejects unknown `models --type` values before list or stats requests, validates text/chat numeric flags against the API schema, and accepts only HTTP(S) URLs for text image inputs before authentication or network access.
gist.impact: CLI users get immediate, actionable validation errors for invalid model types, numeric options, and image URLs, avoiding unnecessary authenticated API and network requests.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful terminal gardener checking three inputs before they enter a cozy API greenhouse: a model-type label rack, a measuring gauge for numeric flags, and a URL watering hose marked HTTP(S). A small CRT monitor robot can eagerly present the validated inputs while code-plants and flowers reinforce that bad seeds are stopped at the gate.
